person.name: John Asbury Thompson
person.notes: Buried at Indian Mission Cemetery, Millsboro, Sussex County, Delaware (grave next to Barthalomew Thompson). Son of John W. Thompson & Sara Ann Thompson; married Hester A. Morris Davis in 1920.
